Answer: C
Reason: The chest X-ray shows patchy, migratory airspace consolidation (visible in the right mid-zone and left lower zone) which is characteristic of Cryptogenic Organizing Pneumonia (COP). The clinical history of a two-month duration with intermittent fever and dry cough fits the subacute presentation of COP, whereas lobar pneumonia would typically present more acutely and tuberculosis usually involves the upper lobes.
